Elsight introduces cellular positioning for Halo

The feature combines multiple inputs when GPS fails and checks satellite positions against cellular-derived location.

DRONELIFE ↗12 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A software-enabled Halo feature

Elsight announced Positioning on October 12 for uncrewed air, ground and maritime systems. Existing Halo customers can enable it through software without additional hardware; new customers still need Halo as the base platform.

Combine cellular and other inputs

The system derives location from cellular network measurements and fuses base-station, motion and trusted GPS inputs. Elsight describes spoofing detection that compares GPS with cellular-derived position and alerts when the difference exceeds a threshold.

Validate the operating environment

The vendor says internet access and visual references are unnecessary, but the method still relies on available cellular measurements. No environment-specific accuracy figures or independent test results are supplied; coverage and behaviour with insufficient inputs remain evaluation questions.
